==Dialogue==
In Tomb of the Primeval Kings:
:''"The servants of chaos struck like a volley of arrows; most did not even have time to raise a defense before they fell. I [[Resurrection|resurrected]] as many as I could and guided them to this portal, but now I fear the Tomb of the Primeval Kings may be lost to us. For each hero I raised from [[death]], hundreds more were surely destroyed. I have sworn a vow to any [[Gods of Tyria|god]] who will listen...I will not leave the gateway until this plague of darkness is ended. The fallen must be avenged."''

In all other locations:
:''"As long as I tend the [[Resurrection Shrine]], I can periodically resurrect fallen members of your [[party]]."
